label: Receiving esse at a moment: passion versus standing composition
resolution: The primitive present-tense receipt (definition 506ea036, Receipt.ReceivesAt) is left open between two defined senses. RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_1 (passionReceipt) reads receiving as the passive correlate of an occurrent giving at the moment; RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2 (standingReceipt) reads it as the standing composition of receiver and received esse while the composite is present. They overlap (in a history where something gives a received-esse thing being whenever it is present they coincide on its moments of presence) and are not exhaustive. The derivations of the present-receipt module (concurrentOfPresentReceipt, onsetOfOnsetReceipt, onsetOfPresentReceipt) are stated over the primitive and use neither sense; they hold on every interpretation. Each sense appears in exactly one closed result: on RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_1 correlativity holds by definition and the present-tense reading is equivalent to weak concurrent actualization 40a97664 (passionReadingIsTheCrux); on RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2 the present-tense reading holds by definition and correlativity is equivalent to 40a97664 (standingReadingIsTheCrux). No argument passes from one sense to the other. The tenseless EsseReceivedIn (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN, disambiguation DISAMB-ESSE-RECEPTION) occurs in both senses as a conjunct and is not itself a sense of this term.
